choice.basis: The May bar is the shortest on the chart, visually corresponding to approximately 8,000 m³ on the y-axis, far below all other displayed months (April ~30,000 m³, January ~40,000 m³, etc.). The chart's visual convention, supported by the absence of an explicit routing threshold or policy in the task instructions, treats relative extremity as a criterion for critical-anomaly escalation. The public task requires a decision based on the dashboard, and the chart's visual representation of May as the lowest value justifies escalation under the implied convention.
choice.option_label: Escalate May to critical low-release anomaly review
